title: Gene Profiles of Mesenchymal Stromal Cells from Different Tissue
description: Mesenchymal stromal stem cells from human bone marrow (BMSCs), adipose tissuse (ADSCs) were purchased from ATCC. Human exfoliated deciduous dental pulps were cultured in vitro and purified to get stem cells from human exfoliated deciduous teeth (SHED). Markers of MSCs were checked before scRNA seq. Overall design: Single cell RNA sequecing on BMSCs, ADSCs and SHED
